body_evidence.label: Hand across the body at release

explanation.basis: Compared with this athlete's 23 other analysed throws (same method version).
evidence: Aim (launched about 2° right of your usual line).
The slide (it slid 14 in further than usual).
Release angle -4.8° against usual (noise 3.0°); on its own, in a drag-free flight, about 8 in less carry.
explanation.observed: Ended off the board, 15 in long and 13 in right of the hole. First contact 2 in past the usual spot.
explanation.observed_detail: First contact 2 in past the usual spot.
explanation.possible_explanation: The difference arose after landing (the slide), not in the flight; no release measure accounts for a single throw's slide.
explanation.suggestion: Watch the landing in the side view (bag flat or on edge, spin) and compare with throws that stayed.

attribution.sentence: Off the board: 15 in long, 13 in right. Most of the long came from the slide (it slid 14 in further than usual).
